description: Centro Storico - riconoscimento UNESCO "Genova: le Strade nuove e il sistema dei palazzi dei Rolli" is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Comune di Genova. "CITTA' VECCHIA" zona di rispetto relativa all'area riconosciuta dall'Unesco come patrimonio dell'umanità "Buffer Zone". Individuazione geografica dell'Area di Rispetto definita nel riconoscimento UNESCO "Genova: le Strade nuove e il sistema dei palazzi dei Rolli". Coverage: the old town of Genoa (UNESCO buffer zone). The portal files it under the publisher Comune di Genova. Its tags are centro-storico, cultura, geografia, turismo. It offers 3 resource(s) in GEOJSON, MAP_SRVC, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-02-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
